The broker consumes only each WorkspaceAttachmentInput.relative_path. r3 exact archive names payload.zip, payload.tar, payload.gz, payload.tar.gz, and payload.tgz are covered through the public filename-suffix/content-type matrix, with payload.tar.gz selected longest-first.

The public parse_request_bytes audit remains readable after close and is published only after the create-new LogparseParseClaim is durably written; normal, claim_reserved, claim_written, and close-race semantics preserve the public validator relationship.

CCR-S07-001 and the claim/request ordering request were resolved by v1-contract-r3 through WorkspaceAttachmentInput.filename_suffix, exact payload<suffix> materialization, and validate_logparse_claim_for_job; no unresolved contract change request remains.

The broker raises the public LogparseBrokerError carrying ExecutionFailure for asset-open failures, emits canonical public ExecutionFailure result files for valid broker execution failures, and keeps authentication or transport failures out of machine result files.

The asset hash uses the resolved Python path required by the frozen fingerprint while process argv preserves the validated absolute lexical virtual-environment launcher so its site-packages remain active.
